breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Treat the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar' and assigns the same internal force of −16000 N to all three segments (AB, BC, CD). This directly repeats the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires segment-by-segment analysis with piecewise constant internal forces that jump at each loading point.
